accepted_departures: departure neighbour_private_kernel: the neighbour router runs through route.neighbour's private kernels (_route_neighbour_grid / _route_neighbour_at), not the approved route_neighbour_loro

departure neighbour_pool_signature: neighbour_pool_loro takes the keyword row_issue_day (U4 needs each row's issue day) and route.solve's solvers take the keyword n_unpenalised (the neighbour design's intercept alone is unpenalised); both await an owner signature

departure fold_gls_entry: the decision surface's per-fold c and GLS weight models are handed out by FitContext.donor_rows_outside and fit.weights.weight_models_for_folds (new entries; for_fold stays unbuilt)

departure table_absent_rows: a non-test row absent from a lead file leaves that lead's banks, c, tolerances, donor-row median, GLS rows and pools; this departs from the accepted grid reading (ladder_h_readings), where such a row stays in the bank with 0-filled features: a table has no feature row at that lead to fill. A guard-surface row absent at its lead refuses, as on grids
departure table_readings: the owner items of SPEC_TABLE_MODE.md section 7 (O1-O27) are built at their listed defaults and await the owner
limits: table features are vouched by the package owner (owner ruling U2): the engine recomputes none of them and checks only the declared feature-end day (T-FEATEND); the G-DERIVED recompute and the look-ahead canary are not run on tables
the table option builds the neighbour router kind only (U3); per-unit and region tables are refused (O16)
the scored rows are the package's test marks (U1), not R18 (2)'s stride pick
the continuity row (continuity.csv), nearest-donor distances and distance bands, report.html and part_draft.md are not built (treeroute_report)
the band is derived from this run's own contrasts; registry/bands.csv and registry/index.csv are not written
'freeze' verdicts are refused: per-cut frozen pools are not built
a time-varying report stratum is reported per row (a string stratum per value, a numeric one by quartiles)
not_headline_reasons: smoke run: plumbing only (R21), smoke deltas carry no sign information
u2_vouched: U2: features vouched by the package owner (owner ruling U2); the engine recomputes none of them

1. every feature and context value of a lead-L row uses only content dated strictly before its issue date, in the source's own day convention (publication delay disclosed per source in exceptions.yaml)
2. no feature reads the row's own label, a label of any test row, or any label dated on or after the issue date
3. the issue date equals the target date minus L days (checked by the engine: T-ISSUE)
4. the same row id means the same sample, with the same label, in every lead file (checked: T-LEADSET)
5. the target date is the label's last content day

6. key_feature_end is the last content day any of the row's feature windows may read; the engine checks that it is before the issue day on every row (T-FEATEND) but cannot check that the declaration is true
the G-DERIVED recompute and the look-ahead canary are not run on tables (U2)
